# vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests

## Overview

Tests that compiled shader binaries use the requested SPIR-V version. The source iterates over SPIR-V versions from
[`SPIRV_VERSION_1_0` to before `SPIRV_VERSION_LAST`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L385-L387)
and registers either compute or graphics-stage cases depending on the factory argument.

## Role

Implementation file

## Test Families

### SPIR-V version checks — Verifies compiled binary SPIR-V version matches request

[`createSpivVersionCheckTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L376-L403)
creates a [`spirv_version`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L382-L383) group and
combines each generated version name with one operation name from the
[`operationNames`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L378-L380) table. Compute calls
register only [`OPERATION_COMPUTE`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L391-L398),
while graphics calls register all non-compute operations through the same loop.

For compute tests,
[`getComputeSourceCode()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L118-L154) emits a simple
shader that negates input floats and stores them to the output buffer. For graphics tests,
[`initGraphicsInstanceContext()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L69-L116) selects
vertex/fragment, tessellation, or geometry pipelines and injects a simple arithmetic
[`testfun`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L86-L96).

## Parameter Dimensions

| Dimension | Values | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| SPIR-V version | [`1_0` through `1_6`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L385-L389) | The requested SPIR-V version currently generated by the loop |
| Operation | [`compute`, `vertex`, `tesselation_evaluation`, `tesselation_control`, `geometry`, `fragment`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L378-L380) | The shader stage or pipeline operation being tested |

## Support / Feature Requirements

- Each test checks that the requested SPIR-V version is supported by comparing it with
  [`getMaxSpirvVersionForAsm`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L274-L278).
- Tessellation operations require the
  [`tessellationShader`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L280-L285) feature.
- Geometry operations require the
  [`geometryShader`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L286-L287) feature.

## Verification Methods

[`isSpirVersionsAsRequested()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L182-L198) iterates
over the binary collection, extracts each binary's SPIR-V version with
[`extractSpirvVersion`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L188-L193), and fails when it
is different from the requested version. Compute instances perform this binary-version check and then run the common
compute verification through
[`SpvAsmComputeShaderInstance::iterate()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L247-L252).
Graphics instances perform the same binary-version check and then call
[`runAndVerifyDefaultPipeline`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L217-L224).

## Notes

- Test names follow the source pattern
  [`{version}_{stage}`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L387-L398), e.g.,
  `1_4_compute` or `1_6_fragment`.
- SPIR-V versions greater than 1.3 use [`StorageBuffer` / `Block`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L121-L135),
  while versions up to 1.3 use `Uniform` / `BufferBlock`.
- SPIR-V versions greater than 1.3 include
  [`%indata %outdata`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L121-L123) in the entry-point
  interface and set graphics
  [`GL_entrypoint`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmSpirvVersionTests.cpp#L98-L99).
